message: You know that feeling when you’ve prepped for something and it finally happens? Yup, I had a little 'I told you so' moment during our last blackout! It’s amazing how having a few simple strategies can make all the difference when the lights go out. If you’re curious about staying calm and collected during power outages, I found a great resource that outlines practical tips. What’s your go-to trick for handling unexpected blackouts? 😊
